rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say you have had enough of something or someone.

example.english: I'm really fed up with Cheung being late every day and making the whole team wait.

rows.note: Choose this when the annoyance feels unbearable or you want to stress that you cannot put up with it.

example.english: The air conditioner has been broken for a whole week; I'm really fed up with this heat.
